title: {Syn} Reed-Solomon Codes Repair Missing Symbols
content:
Reed-Solomon codes add redundant symbols by evaluating polynomials over finite fields. If enough symbols arrive intact, the original message can be reconstructed.

They appear in storage, QR codes, satellite communication, and older media formats because algebra can turn partial damage into recoverable data.

Why it matters: algorithms keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
